To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
The level of physical activity is associated with the occurrence of chronic non-communicable diseases in patients of the Public Health System in Presidente Prudent, SP, Brazil.

1) the prevalence of chronic diseases in patients of the Public Healthcare System of Presidente Prudentesp is high; 2) the occurrence of chronic diseases in these patients is associated with the level of physical activity; 3) there is an association between obesity and chronic diseases; and 4) there is an inverse relationship between the level of physical fitness and chronic diseases.

1) The prevalence of obesity was higher in the 50-59 year age group, 2) The prevalence of hypertension, arrhythmia, and hernia of disk were associated with physical activity, 3) Physical activity was associated with the prevalence of arthritis/osteoarthritis, 4) The prevalence of chronic disease was higher in individuals with a lower level of physical activity.
